cases.title: Explains easing on the learner's own layers with a frame

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1, inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and the reply points to it in one clause: "This is 1 s into its animation, and Title is the faint 'An easing lesson' text in the middle."

The names and counts match the tool output (11 = 10 linear + 1 partly_eased, 6 layers), but turn 1 says Title's four pairs are "all starting at 0.5 s" when one Position pair runs 1.5–3 s, and turn 2 says Title "stops dead at 1.5 s" when the snapshot shows Position continuing to 3 s.
Turn 2 asks the learner to "Ease Title's two Position moves (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity, and say done", only offers one optional demo, and set_ease never runs.

Turn 1 gives the count, the Title proposal and the leave-outs, then ends on the one layer question; turn 2 confirms the layer, gives one frame clause, two idea sentences and a one-sentence how-to, ends on "say done", and puts the demo offer last.
